new-horizons.economy.investor.header: Investor — this week's daily Gold bonus (before income handicap)
new-horizons.economy.investor.help: Fixed at the start of the week: +50 Gold/day per full 5,000 treasury Gold, up to +250 per hero. Changes to your treasury do not change this week's bonus. Already included in the daily income shown in this popup.
new-horizons.economy.resourceBroker.modi: Resource Broker: +%PERCENT% exchange effectiveness. Already included in this quote.
new-horizons.economy.prospector.ready: Prospector: this hero's next eligible owned-mine visit this week grants +%d %s.
new-horizons.economy.prospector.used: Prospector: this hero has already received this week's mine bonus.
new-horizons.economy.prospector.ineligib: Prospector: this resource is neither common nor rare; visiting does not consume this week's bonus.
new-horizons.economy.steward.total: Projected town income: %d Gold/day (after income handicap)
new-horizons.economy.steward.contributio: Steward: +%d Gold/day before income handicap. Already included in the projected total.
new-horizons.economy.steward.help: Each selected Steward who ends the day visiting or garrisoned in this owned town contributes +250 Gold on the next day. Two distinct holders contribute +500. This preview uses current residents; moving them before the day ends changes the next day's income.
new-horizons.economy.magnate.contributio: Magnate: +%d Gold/day before income handicap. Already included in the total.
new-horizons.economy.magnate.none: This town is not currently receiving a Magnate award.
new-horizons.economy.magnate.help: At week start, each selected Magnate awards the most recently visited owned town from the previous week +500 Gold/day for seven days. Two holders may award the same town. The town must still be owned at week start; later visits do not redirect this fixed award.
